text:
alex: Heads-up — I started a draft Grafana dashboard for node hot-swap latency and its correlation with evictions + power spikes. Goal: single view for ops when nodes get hot-swapped and we see >99p latency blips that lead to Pod reschedules. feedback?

maria: Nice. Can you add an occupancy vs hot-swap-latency panel? Want to see if fragmentation + high occupancy correlates.

alex: yes — planning a combined heatmap: y=node_slot_count (binned) x=hot_swap_latency buckets; overlay 99p line for evictions. thinking of using a recording rule to compress histogram data.

sam: pls remember cardinality — per-pod_id labels kill grafana. Use relabeling or label_replace to strip instance IDs in recording rules.

jin: question: which metrcs are you using for hot-swap? we have a custom histogram from allocator: `node_hot_swap_duration_seconds_bucket` and evictions counter `kube_pod_evictions_total`.

alex: exactly. initial PromQL for 99p: ```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(node_hot_swap_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, node))
```
but I'm going to add a recording rule: ```
- record: node:hot_swap_duration:rate_5m
  expr: sum(rate(node_hot_swap_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, node)
```
so panels query `histogram_quantile(0.99, node:hot_swap_duration:rate_5m)` to reduce load.

maria: good. For the heatmap, consider bucketing node occupancy: `floor(node_allocatable_gpus / 4) * 4` or just `slot_bin` label in a recording rule so we can group.

sam: also add a derived metric for transient power spikes: avg_over_time(node_power_watts[2m]) and a delta `node_power_watts - avg_over_time(node_power_watts[30m])` to catch sudden jumps.

alex: ok adding panel for `power_jump_pct = (avg_over_time(node_power_watts[2m]) - avg_over_time(node_power_watts[30m])) / avg_over_time(node_power_watts[30m])` and color by threshold >15%.

jin: alert tuning idea: don't alert on raw >99p for single node. Alert on cluster-level rate of nodes with >99p in last 10m > 3 or percent of active nodes >5%. avoids noisy on-call.

maria: +1. Also annotate scheduled maintenance windows and autoscaler events (we can push annotations via the `ops-annotations` endpoint) so graphs explain spikes.

alex: will add annotations and an `ops.event` stream panel. thinking about a compact row that shows: 99p hot-swap, eviction-rate (5m), power-jump-count (2m), and a link to the node detail dashboard.

sam: small nit: use Prometheus recording rules to precompute `node:hot_swap_99p:rate_5m` and `node:power_jump:count_2m` so the dashboard loads fast. We should also use `max_over_time` for evictions to avoid double counting.

alex: noted. Also want a histo+sparklines tile for top-10 offending nodes and a sparkline of their tail-latency so SRE can quickly triage.

jin: for region constraints: add a variable $region and a multi-region rollup panel (use `sum by(region)(...)`). some clusters have different thermal curves — region baselines matter when setting thresholds.

maria: cost note: if we see persistent hot-swap latency in a region and it's driven by high occupancy, ops should consider bumping Dedicated pool capacity vs rebalancing tenants. add a note in dashboard docs how to cost-evaluate (tokens saved vs GPU reservation cost).

alex: will add a small markdown panel with runbook links and cost calc examples. Also adding a link to the compact PromQL snippets we used.

sam: can you post the draft link when ready? I'll review panel thresholds and overall cardinality.

alex: posting draft now: https://grafana.company.internal/d/abcd123/node-hot-swap-latency-agg (draft access: eng-infra + ops) :eyes:

deploy-bot: dashboard "node-hot-swap-latency-agg" created by alex (draft) at 2267003456

jin: quick thumbs — looks solid from a metrics side. pls include raw node exporter labels in the node detail link for deeper debugging.

maria: :thumbsup: once sam signs off, we can move this to default fleet dashboards and add to the weekly on-call rotation doc.

sam: reviewing now, will push a few minor recording-rule changes and then ack.

alex: thanks all — will iterate and post final.
